{{Quote|He was nothing but a bounty hunter and assassin who had the good fortune to be born with the ability to touch the Force.|Hetton|<ref name="rot" />}}
'''Gula Dwan''' was a [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], he was selected by the wealthy [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Loranda]] to teach her son, [[Hetton]], about [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. However, Hetton found Dwan to be a worthless teacher, and after a short time, he [[Death/Legends|killed]] him.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Over the years he had gleaned a simple understanding of the most basic techniques to access his power, allowing him to levitate small objects and perform other similar tricks.|Hetton|<ref name="rot" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]], Gula Dwan was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]]. He was also [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and had learned a number of minor [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] throughout his life, such as the ability to [[Telekinesis/Legends|levitate]] small objects.<ref name="rot" /> At some point before [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Dwan was recruited by [[Loranda]], a wealthy [[Human/Legends|Human]] female from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. Loranda sought someone to teach her son, [[Hetton]], in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and had stumbled upon the Duros. She offered him a large sum of [[Currency/Legends|money]]; as someone who was motivated by [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Dwan eagerly accepted.<ref name="rot" />

However, Hetton found that Dwan had little to teach him. Thanks to his family's substantial wealth, Hetton was able to discover a number of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] and old volumes. From the manuscripts that he recovered, Hetton learned more about the Force than he had been taught under Dwan. After his skills surpassed Dwan's own, the pupil [[Death/Legends|killed]] his teacher at the urging of his mother.<ref name="rot" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|But he paid no allegiance to the Sith or the Jedi; Gula's own fealty was to whoever paid him the most credits.|Hetton|<ref name="rot" />}}
Gula Dwan was a being motivated by money. He was willing to work for whomever would pay him the most, no matter their ideals. After being contacted by Loranda, he agreed to work for her and teach her son, as she had promised to pay him a great deal of credits. However, Dwan was a subpar teacher. Hetton quickly grew tired of his instructor, considering Dwan a simple [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who happened to be Force-sensitive, and he was eager to kill Dwan when the time came.<ref name="rot" />

==Powers and abilities==
Dwan had minor Force-sensitivity and used his connection to the Force to guide his actions.<ref name="cswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Gula Dwan was mentioned in the [[2007]] novel ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', written by [[Drew Karpyshyn]].<ref name="rot" />
